vi: Deploy ElastiCache Redis replication group (1 primary + 2 replica) với automatic_failover + multi_az enabled, enable transit_encryption + at_rest_encryption bắt buộc tại create.
So sánh Redis vs Memcached: Redis có persistence + replication + data structure rich; Memcached đơn giản LRU cache, không persistence, rẻ hơn.
Index document vào OpenSearch domain + run search query qua REST API, hiểu vì sao OpenSearch fork Elasticsearch 7.10 sau khi AWS mất quyền contribute.
Deploy MSK cluster (Kafka managed) với IAM SASL auth thay vì plain SASL, produce + consume topic bằng kafka console tools từ EC2 bastion.
Quyết định managed vs self-host: managed cover ops overhead (backup, patch, failover), self-host rẻ ~30% nhưng đòi DBA full-time, phù hợp team <5 engineer.
en: Deploy an ElastiCache Redis replication group (1 primary + 2 replicas) with automatic_failover and multi_az enabled; enable transit_encryption and at_rest_encryption, both immutable at creation.
Compare Redis vs Memcached: Redis has persistence, replication, and rich data structures; Memcached is a simple LRU cache with no persistence and lower cost.
Index documents into an OpenSearch domain and run search queries over the REST API; understand why OpenSearch forked from Elasticsearch 7.10 after AWS lost upstream contribution rights.
Deploy an MSK cluster (managed Kafka) with IAM SASL authentication instead of plain SASL; produce and consume topics using kafka console tools from an EC2 bastion.
Decide managed vs self-host: managed covers ops overhead (backups, patches, failover); self-host costs 30% less but requires full-time DBA, suitable for teams smaller than 5 engineers.
